Located at the border of Jeferson County and Boulder County just east of the foothills of the Front Range, the Flatirons Campus has abundant energy resources that are critical for the variety of projects conducted at the campus. The Flatirons Campus is in the city of Arvada near the intersection of Colorado Highway 93 and Colorado Highway 128, between Boulder and Golden. It is approximately 15 miles (24.2 km) north of the STM Campus.
